certification.name: CREST Certified Red Team Manager
certification.description: Advanced certification for those who lead red team engagements, with a three-hour multiple-choice and long-form exam and a three-hour scenario exam taken at selected Pearson VUE centres. Formerly the CREST Certified Simulated Attack Manager (CCSAM).
certification.currency_note: Certified-level exams are listed at GBP 1,600 in two separately booked parts; the page does not say whether the price covers both parts
